ABOUT JUSTIN

The person behind the transaction.

Justin Ostow has been a licensed Realtor since 2006, building his career around the Tampa Bay market and an unusually broad range of real estate transactions.

His experience extends from residential buyers and sellers to investment properties, multi-family, land, commercial real estate, development projects, short sales, and foreclosures.

Away from work, Justin is a husband and a father, and a Tampa Bay resident who grew up in Seminole.
